📖 Course Sections | أقسام الدورة

GME 203 | الكود: GME 203 ---

English

This comprehensive course provides a roadmap for implementing experiential learning in quality improvement within Graduate Medical Education programs. Participants will explore evidence-based models for experiential learning, practical strategies for facilitation, and assessment methods to measure learning outcomes. The curriculum is specifically designed for Saudi healthcare institutions, with adaptation to SCFHS requirements, CBAHI educational standards, and Vision 2030 quality initiatives. The course builds upon foundational GME concepts and advances to implementation-level skills for medical educators, program directors, and quality leaders in teaching hospitals. Estimated Time of Completion: 2 hours | المدة المقدرة للإنجاز: ساعتان

العربية

تقدم هذه الدورة الشاملة خارطة طريق لتنفيذ التعلم التجريبي في مجال تحسين الجودة ضمن برامج التعليم الطبي العالي. سيستكشف المشاركون نماذج قائمة على الأدلة للتعلم التجريبي، واستراتيجيات عملية للتيسير، وطرق التقييم لقياس مخرجات التعلم. تم تصميم المنهج خصيصاً للمؤسسات الصحية السعودية، مع التكيف مع متطلبات SCFHS، ومعايير التعليم CBAHI، ومبادرات جودة رؤية ٢٠٣٠. تبني الدورة على مفاهيم التعليم الطبي العالي الأساسية وتتقدم إلى مهارات مستوى التنفيذ للمنظمين الطبيين ومديري البرامج وقادة الجودة في المستشفيات التعليمية. ---

English Learning Outcomes

Upon successful completion of this course, learners will be able to: 1. Compare three models for experiential learning in healthcare quality improvement 2. Design experiential learning activities that meet adult learning principles and competency requirements 3. Implement facilitation strategies to maximize learner engagement in QI activities 4. Develop assessment tools to evaluate experiential learning outcomes 5. Integrate experiential QI learning into residency program structures 6. Create evaluation frameworks to measure program effectiveness 7. Adapt learning models to Saudi healthcare institutional context 8. Establish mentorship systems for supporting resident QI projects

مخرجات التعلم بالعربية

عند إتمام هذه الدورة بنجاح، سيتمكن المتعلمون من: 1. مقارنة ثلاثة نماذج للتعلم التجريبي في تحسين جودة الرعاية الصحية 2. تصميم أنشطة التعلم التجريبية التي تلبي مبادئ تعلم البالغين ومتطلبات الكفاءة 3. تنفيذ استراتيجيات التيسير لزيادة مشاركة المتعلمين في أنشطة QI 4. تطوير أدوات تقييم لتقييم مخرجات التعلم التجريبية 5. دمج تعلم QI التجريبي في هياكل برامج الإقامة 6. إنشاء أطر تقييم لقياس فعالية البرنامج 7. تكييف نماذج التعلم لل سياق المؤسسي الصحي السعودي 8. إنشاء أنظمة إرشاد لدعم مشاريع QI للمقيمين ---

Lesson 1: Models for Experiential Learning | الدرس الأول: نماذج التعلم التجريبي

English Content

1.1 Experiential Learning Theory Foundation Experiential learning, pioneered by John Dewey and developed by David Kolb, forms the theoretical foundation for effective adult learning in healthcare. The cyclical nature of experiential learning ensures continuous development through the integration of experience, reflection, conceptualization, and application. Kolb's Experiential Learning Cycle ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ KOLB'S EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING CYCLE │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ CONCRETE EXPERIENCE │ │ │ │ (Active Engagement) │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ • Hands-on practice │◀──────┐ │ │ │ • Direct involvement │ │ │ │ │ • Sensory learning │ │ │ │ └───────────┬────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ Reflective │ Active │ │ │ Observation │ Experimentation │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ │ │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ │ REFLECTIVE │ │ │ │ │ OBSERVATION │───────┘ │ │ │ (Reflection) │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ • Self-assessment │ │ │ │ • Peer discussion │ │ │ │ • Journaling │ │ │ └───────────┬────────────┘ │ │ │ ┌────────────────┐ │ │ │ Abstract │ ACTIVE │ │ │ │ Conceptualization │ EXPERIMENT- │ │ │ │ │ ATION │ │ │ ▼ │ (Application) │ │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ ABSTRACT │──────▶│ • Testing │ │ │ │ CONCEPTUALIZATION │ │ • Problem- │ │ │ │ (Theory Building) │ │ solving │ │ │ │ │ │ • Innovation │ │ │ │ • Theory integration │ └───────┬────────┘ │ │ │ • Evidence synthesis │ │ │ │ │ • Pattern recognition│ │ │ │ └────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ ▼ │ │ CONTINUOUS CYCLE OF LEARNING ◀─────┘ │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 1.2 Three Models for Experiential Learning in QI Model 1: Project-Based Learning (PBL)

Exercise 1: Design an Experiential Learning Activity

Instructions: Design an experiential learning activity for teaching PDSA methodology to residents. Required Elements: 1. Learning objectives (aligned with milestones) 2. Activity description with clear steps 3. Materials needed 4. Time allocation 5. Assessment method 6. Adaptation for Saudi context

Exercise 2: Create a Community of Practice Launch Plan

Instructions: Develop a plan for launching a QI Community of Practice in your institution. Template: ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ COMMUNITY OF PRACTICE LAUNCH PLAN │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ Community Name: ____________________________________________ │ │ Mission Statement: ________________________________________ │ │ Target Members: ____________________________________________ │ │ Launch Date: _______________ │ │ │ │ STRUCTURE │ │ Meeting Frequency: _______________ │ │ Meeting Format: _______________ │ │ Communication Platform: _______________ │ │ │ │ ACTIVITIES │ │ Initial Agenda Items: │ │ 1. _______________________________________________________ │ │ 2. _______________________________________________________ │ │ 3. _______________________________________________________ │ │ │ │ BUDGET │ │ Refreshments: _______________ │ │ Materials: _______________ │ │ Technology: _______________ │ │ │ │ PROMOTION PLAN │ │ Marketing Channels: _______________________________________ │ │ Launch Event: ____________________________________________ │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ---

Case Study: Transitioning from Traditional Teaching to Experiential Learning

Setting: Saudi Teaching Hospital, Jeddah Challenge: Replace lecture-based QI teaching with experiential learning Situation: Dr. Abdullah Al-Hakami, Program Director of Internal Medicine, recognizes that traditional QI teaching through lectures has not resulted in resident QI competency. Residents can recite PDSA steps but cannot apply them to real clinical problems. Your Task: 1. Diagnose the current state of QI education 2. Design transition plan to experiential learning 3. Address faculty development needs 4. Create assessment system to demonstrate competency 5. Plan evaluation of the new approach Key Questions to Address: - What resistance might faculty encounter? - How will you maintain curriculum coverage? - What resources are needed for experiential learning? - How will you measure success? ---

Quiz 1: Experiential Learning Models

Q1: Which model involves extended, substantial projects with high resident ownership? - A) Community of Practice - B) Project-Based Learning - C) Intensive Workshop - D) Traditional Lecture Q2: Kolb's concrete experience stage is characterized by: - A) Theory building - B) Abstract conceptualization - C) Active engagement in tasks - D) Reflective observation Q3: The Community of Practice model is best suited for: - A) Skills acquisition - B) Culture change - C) Research projects - D) Board exam preparation

Quiz 2: Implementation

Q1: Backwards design begins with: - A) Content selection - B) Activity planning - C) Desired results - D) Assessment creation Q2: Effective mentorship requires what time commitment for primary mentor? - A) 1 hour/month - B) 1-2 hours/week - C) 2-4 hours/week - D) 10 hours/week Q3: Which platform is recommended for QI community communication in Saudi hospitals? - A) Facebook Groups - B) WhatsApp - C) Microsoft Teams - D) Snapchat

Quiz 3: Assessment

Q1: Kirkpatrick Level 3 evaluates: - A) Satisfaction - B) Knowledge gain - C) Behavioral change - D) Organizational results Q2: A QI portfolio should include: - A) Only project results - B) Complete learning journey documentation - C) Only faculty feedback - D) Board exam scores Q3: EPAs for QI competency focus on: - A) Theoretical knowledge - B) Demonstrated performance in practice - C) Written examinations - D) Peer popularity ---
